name: Voice commands help
description: Help mode entries for the Voice commands plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Voice commands
entries.text: Everything you can say to the apps: the Dev Console, AmberX, axHub web, Molly, Expenses and every app built for the framework. Say or type a command at the top; the lists below show the phrases per app.

entries.title: Say it
entries.text: Runs what you typed as a voice command: reads and navigation run at once, a write asks only for what is missing, anything that deletes asks first.

entries.title: Speak
entries.text: Listens through the microphone (where the browser can) and runs what it heard. Tap again to stop listening.

entries.title: Yes
entries.text: Confirms the command the question is about and runs it.

entries.title: Apps
entries.text: Pick an app to see only its phrases and to send commands to it alone, or Every app to let the phrase decide.

entries.title: Every app
entries.text: Shows every app's phrases and lets what you say pick the app (start with the app's name, like "expenses, add 5 food", to aim it).

entries.title: Last commands
entries.text: The last voice commands that ran through this console: what was said, which app and command it became, who said it and whether it ran.

entries.title: Microphone button
entries.text: Shows the Speak button wherever the browser can listen. Off: type the commands.

entries.title: Speak the answers
entries.text: Reads answers and questions aloud with the browser's voice. Off: answers only show on screen.

entries.title: Language
entries.text: The language the microphone listens in and answers are spoken in, as a BCP 47 tag such as en-US.

entries.title: Hosts allowed to talk to this console
entries.text: Pages that may frame this console and send voice commands through it, by origin, comma-separated. Molly is there by default; anything else is ignored.

entries.title: Voice commands
entries.text: The Voice commands settings: microphone, spoken answers, language, the hosts that may talk to this console, a box to try a command and the last commands run.

entries.title: Voice commands
entries.text: Opens the Voice commands screen: say or type a command to any app, and read what each app understands.

entries.title: Say a command
entries.text: A small dialog to say or type one command without leaving the screen you are on.

entries.title: Say a command…
entries.text: Opens the Say a command dialog.

steps.say: Type or speak a command here. Try: what can I say in expenses?
Every app lists its phrases below; pick one app to narrow it down.
